'''Stonroy Soma''' was a [[human]] who served as an [[aide]] in the [[Alderaanian delegation]] of the [[Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]<ref name="VE" /> in [[32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' states that Stonroy Soma was an [[aide]] in the [[Alderaanian delegation]] at the same [[time]] as the [[Battle of Naboo]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates to [[32 BBY]].</ref> Soma served alongside fellow aides [[Liana Merian]] and [[Agrippa Aldrete]],<ref name="VE" /> and the [[Senator]] for the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]], [[Bail Antilles]],<ref name="HC34">{{HelmetCollectionCite|34|Weapons & Uniforms}}</ref> during the [[Invasion of Naboo|Naboo Crisis]].<ref name="VE" /> The human at one point sat with Aldrete and Antilles in a [[repulsorpod]] in<ref name="HC34" /> the [[Imperial Senate Building|Galactic Senate Building]] on the planet [[Coruscant]]. Soma had light skin and [[Color|brown]] [[hair]]. The aide [[Clothing|donned]] a [[draped overcloak]] of mauve fabric ornated with square motifs and [[gold]]en lining, under which an ankle-length white tunic was worn.<ref name="VE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stonroy Soma was a character created to appear in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="Deleted">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga|scene=Vote of No Confidence}}</ref> in a scene filmed on B Stage at [[Leavesden Studios]] [[June 30]], [[1997]].<ref name="Filming">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref> However, the scene the character appeared in was ultimately cut from the final release. In the deleted scene, Soma sits with Merian, Aldrete, and Antilles in a repulorspod in the Senate Building while [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] calls for a [[Vote of No Confidence]] in [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]]. Antilles, who at that time was identified as [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]], then stands and seconds the motion.<ref name="Deleted" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first mentioned in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="VE" />
